### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>mattn/go-sqlite3 (github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3)</summary>

### [`v1.14.53`](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/releases/tag/v1.14.53): 1.14.53

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/compare/v1.14.52...v1.14.53)

#### What's Changed

- Fuse bind and first step into one CGO crossing by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​1455](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1455)
- Fuse step and column fetch into one CGO crossing in Next by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​1460](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1460)
- fix: release replaced authorizer callbacks by [@​ryanchou1994](https://redirect.github.com/ryanchou1994) in [#​1458](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1458)
- Return an error instead of crashing when a connection is used after Close by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​1462](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1462)
- Report missing arguments when Exec has no arguments by [@​laodouya](https://redirect.github.com/laodouya) in [#​1471](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1471)
- Upgrade SQLite to version [`3540100`](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/commit/3540100) by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​1472](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1472)

#### New Contributors

- [@​ryanchou1994](https://redirect.github.com/ryanchou1994) made their first contribution in [#​1458](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1458)
- [@​laodouya](https://redirect.github.com/laodouya) made their first contribution in [#​1471](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1471)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/compare/v1.14.52...v1.14.53>

</details>
